name: Orme-Gray Fountain
description: Fountain on a grassy lawn, almost inside the courtyard formed by the Orme-Gray buildings.

name: Tree of Life
description: The Tree of Life: a very pretty large tree in the garden in front of Sage Hall.

name: Sage Hall Garden (Benches)
description: Garden in front of Sage Hall on the Safadi Fine Arts side, with benches.

name: Cat Area
description: Patch of grass behind Sage Hall where the campus cats hang out, with a small cat house.

name: Amphitheater
description: Outdoor amphitheater with tiered seating, just below the Upper Gate.

name: Vine Benches
description: Benches under a vine-covered pergola, between Sage Hall and Orme-Gray.

name: Vine Benches (Gym entrance)
description: Benches under a vine-covered pergola in front of the Gymnasium entrance, between the tennis field and University Services.

name: Registrar's Office
description: Student records: grades, transcripts, diplomas and graduation. The help desk is behind the double door at the front of Irwin Hall.
note: The registrar page says 'Ground Floor'; the FM directory says Level 1, Room 101. Irwin's Level 1 is the street-level floor, so they probably mean the same place.

name: Business Office (Cashier)
description: Payment of fees, deposits, deferred payment and application fees, at the cashier window. Behind the double door at the front of Irwin Hall.
note: The FM directory (2016) lists the room as Level 1, Room 106 and also lists a second 'Business Office (Cashier)' at Irwin Level 6, Room 601A (the finance wing). Level and room here come from the directory.

name: Admissions Office
description: Applications, acceptances, admission requirements, equivalence of foreign degrees, entrance exams and transfers.
note: Level and room come from the 2016 FM directory (confirmed as Level 2 by the 2020 Irwin building page).

name: Financial Aid & Scholarships Office
description: Financial aid applications and interviews, scholarships, loans and grants.

name: Academic Advising
description: Academic advisors for course planning and student success. Advisor names, emails and extensions are on the official page.
note: The 'Career and Advising Center' (Rooms 303–305) on the advising page uses Byblos phone numbers, so it is a Byblos facility and is not on this map. The FM directory (2016) lists Beirut advising in Rooms 410, 417 and 419; the advising page also lists Room 416.

name: Testing Services Office
description: Entrance exams, including the English Entrance Exam (EEE).
note: Sources disagree: the Orme-Gray building page (2022) and the FM directory (2016, as 'Institutional Research and Assessment (Testing Services)', Room 302) say Orme-Gray Level 3; the Student Center page (2021) lists a 'Testing Services Office' on WKSC Level 2. The newer page is used (Orme-Gray); please confirm on campus.

name: Career Development Services
description: Help with choosing a major, job-application skills, internships and placement (Career Guidance and Placement).
note: Room comes only from the 2016 FM services directory.

name: Student Recruitment Office
description: Campus visits and general information about LAU, majors, applications and deadlines.

name: Writing Center
description: Help with academic writing. There is also a Writing Center station on Level 13 of the library.
note: Room number is not listed in the FM sources.

name: Dean of Students Department
description: Student clubs, activities, student elections and commencement.

name: Campus Student Activities
description: Support for student clubs and campus events.
note: Room comes only from the 2016 FM services directory.

name: Counseling Services
description: Support for stress, anxiety, loneliness, depression and other personal matters.
note: Room comes only from the 2016 FM services directory.

name: Health Services (Infirmary)
description: First aid, injuries, illness and help with emergency hospitalization.
note: The 2016 FM services directory says Level 2, Room 303B; the 2021 public-spaces directory and the Student Center page say Level 3 (lobby). The newer one is used.

name: International Services and Programs Office (ISP)
description: Exchange programs, study abroad and coming to Lebanon.
note: The FM directory (2016) says Room 203 and also lists an 'International Services Office' at WKSC Level 5, Room 502C; the ISP contact page says Nicol Hall, Room 205 and is used.

note: The Athletics page contradicts itself: its text says 7:00–18:00, its hours table says 7:00–20:00 (used). Location: FM public spaces (2021) says WKSC Level 1, Room 101.

name: Indoor Basketball Court (Gymnasium)
description: Indoor court in the Joseph G. Jabbra Gymnasium. Volleyball is also played here (not confirmed by LAU). Entrance under the tennis field; the stairs down beside Irwin Hall lead to it.
note: Hours come from the Athletics website (a student reported different hours). Volleyball use is not confirmed on any LAU page.

name: Swimming Pool
description: Indoor pool in the Gymnasium (reported as heated, 20 m × 12 m; not confirmed by LAU). Entrance under the tennis field; the stairs down beside Irwin Hall lead to it.
note: LAU's facilities page puts the pool on Gymnasium Level 2 (below the lobby). The size and heating were reported by a student and are not confirmed by LAU.

name: Green courts (tennis)
description: Two outdoor tennis courts with artificial grass on the Gymnasium roof, next to Safadi Fine Arts. Reserve via the Athletics Office.
hours: By reservation: in person at the Athletics Office, at least 24 hours ahead
note: Lighting and artificial grass were reported by a student and are not confirmed by LAU pages.

name: Dance Room (Gymnasium)
description: Dance room. Reserve via the Athletics Office.

name: Dance Room (Student Center)
description: Dance room. Reserve via the Athletics Office.

name: Athletics Office
description: Sports, gym, varsity teams and competitions. There is no online booking page: reserve courts, the pool and dance rooms through this office.
note: Room comes from the FM directory (2016). Phone 76-744113 and athletics@lau.edu.lb appear on the Athletics site.
